properties.site-address: Land adjacent to former Kwik Save, Walkergate, Berwick-upon-Tweed
properties.notes: Cleared land close to the town centre that is available for redevelopment. Site comprises of hardstanding and has been used for car parking. There is known interest in taking forward a project and the adjacent retail store has recently been redeveloped for new office space. A new residential scheme could complement this development. A higher-density could be fitting given the central location, with a flatted/apartment scheme potentially being appropriate. The site is identified as an allocation in the draft Local Plan (submitted May 2019).
